# DMPG-retningslinjen: Udredning af ADHD hos børn og unge i hospitalsregi og speciallægepraksis

The DMPG-retningslinjen ("Udredning af ADHD hos børn og unge i hospitalsregi og speciallægepraksis") is a national Danish clinical guideline for diagnosing ADHD in children and young people, issued for use in hospital settings and specialist medical practice. It was published in early 2025 [^src1], and it plays a direct role in the story told by ADHD-databasens årsrapport for 2024, the national quality report on ADHD diagnosis and treatment in Denmark covering the period 01.04.2024–31.03.2025.

According to the report, several Danish regions have said the guideline has strengthened management-level support for prioritizing the diagnostic elements it recommends [^src1]. Two regions in particular, [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] and [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]], point to the guideline as the reason they have moved to prioritize somatic (physical) examinations as part of ADHD diagnostic workups [^src3]. The report's steering group ("Styregruppen") explicitly endorses this reading of the guideline, stating that a somatic examination is judged to be an essential part of ADHD assessment — both to rule out possible somatic differential diagnoses and to catch any co-occurring physical conditions [^src3].

The guideline's influence extends beyond somatic screening. Two of the report's quality indicators are explicitly built to mirror its recommendations: one indicator, tied to gathering information about a child's or young person's daily life in daycare/school settings, is described as following the guideline's wording [^src2], and a related, newly introduced indicator is likewise said to lean on the DMPG guideline for ADHD assessment [^src2]. This places the guideline at the center of how Denmark's ADHD quality-monitoring indicators (including Indikator 1, Indikator 2a, Indikator 2b, and Indikator 3, discussed elsewhere in the same report) were designed and interpreted for the 2024–2025 reporting period.

Taken together, these mentions show a guideline that, within months of its early-2025 publication, was already shaping clinical practice and management priorities in at least two Danish regions, and was being used as a reference point for revising national quality indicators in child and adolescent ADHD diagnosis.

## Mentions

- Page 5: "Flere regioner giver udtryk for at DMPG-retningslinjen: Udredning af ADHD hos børn og unge i hospitalsregi og speciallægepraksis, som udkom i starten af 2025, har haft betydning ift. at der er kommet ledelsesmæssig opbakning til at opprioritere de udredningselementer, der anbefales i DMPG-retningslinjen" [^src1]
- Page 22: "Denne indikator læner sig op ad formuleringerne i DMPG-retningslinjen for ADHD ift. at der bør indhentes oplysninger om barnets/den unges dagligdag i institution/skole." [^src2]
- Page 22: "Denne nye indikator læner sig ligeledes op ad DMPG-retningslinjen for ADHD-udredningen." [^src2]
- Page 12: "man har opprioriteret at få foretaget somatisk undersøgelse pga. anbefalinger i nylige DMPG-retningslinjer vedrørende udredning af ADHD" [^src3]
- Page 13: "Styregruppen vurderer jævnfør DMPG-retningslinjen, at somatisk undersøgelse er en væsentlig del af udredningen af ADHD" [^src3]

## Claims

**Guideline development**
- DMPG-retningslinjen: Udredning af ADHD hos børn og unge i hospitalsregi og speciallægepraksis udkom i starten af 2025 [^src1] (dmpg-guideline-adhd-children-youth) (Page 5)

**Clinical rationale**
- I Region Midt og Region Hovedstaden har man opprioriteret at få foretaget somatisk undersøgelse pga. anbefalinger i nylige DMPG-retningslinjer vedrørende udredning af ADHD (region-midtjylland, region-hovedstaden, dmpg-guideline-adhd-children-youth, indikator-1) [^src3] (Page 12)
- Styregruppen vurderer jævnfør DMPG-retningslinjen, at somatisk undersøgelse er en væsentlig del af udredningen af ADHD både ift. mulige somatiske differentialdiagnoser og evt. samtidigt optrædende somatiske tilstande (dmpg-guideline-adhd-children-youth, indikator-1) [^src3] (Page 13)
